issues.body: is_status_evaluator_artifact() still classifies every check named `ci-summary status` as an evaluator artifact without authenticating its workflow/run provenance. run_gate() applies that name-only exclusion globally, not merely to SELF_RUN_ID. A same-repository PR can define a normal failing or pending job with that exact name; the required `ci-summary / gate` then removes the real leg and can succeed despite it. SELF_RUN_ID only anchors the current evaluator's own run and does not repair this broader exclusion. The added test continues to assert name-only behavior rather than an adversarial provenance case.
issues.fix_hint: Exclude only checks proven to originate from the trusted default-branch ci-summary-status workflow, or only explicitly anchored evaluator run IDs. Add an adversarial test in which a pull-request workflow emits an exact-name failing check and prove it remains gating while a genuine evaluator check is excluded.
issues.title: Name-only artifact exclusion still permits a required-gate bypass

issues.body: The trigger still omits `workflow_run.workflows`, and the workflow comments explicitly state that the assumed subscribe-to-all behavior is unverified and may fail silently. The tests only inspect YAML text and do not establish that GitHub accepts and dispatches this configuration. Consequently the stage-1 transport may never run or publish parity evidence, leaving the implementation incomplete for its stated observational purpose.
issues.fix_hint: Use a GitHub-supported, validated trigger whose upstream semantics are established, and add schema/runtime evidence that it dispatches. If GitHub requires an explicit workflows list and enumeration is unacceptable, redesign the event transport before merging rather than shipping a knowingly silent no-op possibility.
issues.title: workflow_run event source remains knowingly unverified

verdict.summary: Round 2 is stagnant: both prior defects remain materially unchanged. The evaluator-artifact filter still excludes checks solely by their PR-controllable job name, so a same-repository PR can hide a failing or pending leg from the required legacy gate. The workflow also still ships an unverified workflow_run trigger without a workflows selector; comments explicitly concede that it may never fire. Stage-1 observational status does not make either defect acceptable because this change alters the currently required gate's sibling filtering immediately.
